card: Choose which Android apps can use the network.
title: NetCage for an app that should stay offline
intro: NetCage lets you refuse a selected Android app access to Wi-Fi, mobile data or both while the rest of the phone stays online.

sections.heading: What can NetCage refuse?
sections.body: It can block connections for a selected Android app while other apps stay online.

sections.heading: Can Wi-Fi and mobile data differ?
sections.body: Choose Wi-Fi, mobile data or both for a rule.

sections.heading: Can rules follow a schedule?
sections.body: Profiles group app rules and can apply them on selected days and times.

sections.heading: Where does NetCage fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell needs a connection for many of its screens. NetCage gives Android users a separate choice about which app may use Wi-Fi or mobile data.
